title.native: シュヴァルツェスマーケン

description:
The year is 1983. The Cold War is in full effect, and humanity is under attack. Strange aliens, given the name "BETA," have descended to Earth and have been destroying all life. Soldiers have been tasked with piloting large combat suits called Tactical Surface Fighters (TSF) to repel the alien invaders, but the front line is slowly being pushed back towards the surviving cities.

Schwarzesmarken follows the story of Theodor Eberbach and the other members of the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken (Black Marks), a ruthless unit that values a mission's completion over human life. Stationed in East Germany on the Oder-Neisse line and led by war hero Captain Irisdina Bernhard, the unit specializes in counterassault attacks on laser-class BETA. But the 666th Squadron finds itself with more enemies than just the alien forces when optimistic rookie Katia Waldheim joins the squadron, drawing the attention of East Germany's secret police, the Stasi.

name.native: テオドール・エーベルバッハ
alternative: Heavy Laser-Class Killer (重光線級殺し)

node.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5' 11")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

A surface pilot of the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken. Theodor fights purely for his own survival, rejecting everything else that might leave himself vulnerable, from his comrades in the 666th, to the country he grew up in and describes as rotten and most people in it. Though much younger than other members of the 666th, Theodor's skills are up there with the best, specializing in close combat he learned through knife self-defense.

Growing up an orphan in an abusive children's home, Theodor was adopted by the Hohenstein family, where he was given peace, rest and emotions for the first time. After being captured by the Stasi in a failed attempt to defect to West Germany with them, he was tortured and his family was killed, giving him a deep hatred for the Stasi and anyone involved with them. When Theodor was released, he decided to join the military to survive.

name.native: アイリスディーナ・ベルンハルト

node.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5' 8")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Captain
__TSF:__ MiG-21PF Balalaika

Commander of the ‘East Germany’s Strongest’, the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken, and [Jürgen Bernhard](https://anilist.co/character/261257/Bernhard-Jrgen)'s beloved younger sister. The Captain made her name known and infamous during Operation Palaiologos, became known as a hero during the Poland retreat, and later gained fame across Europe with her Schwarzesmarken squadron. 

Her command and development of the 666th make her one of the few capable of carrying out Laserjagd, typically considered "suicide" missions in strategic doctrine Jürgen created and Irisdina perfected, taking it to new heights.

Growing up, the kind-hearted Iris was virtually unmatched as the top student, until she met [Beatrix Brehme](https://anilist.co/character/179971/Brehme-Beatrix). The two became best friends, national level synchronized divers and later the top 2 graduates at the TSF academy, and remain connected in many ways as East Germany’s best pilots.

name.native: リィズ・ホーエンシュタイン

node.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5' 3")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Theodor Eberbach's step-sister, Lise Hohenstein was thought to have been killed by the Stasi 3 years ago when their family attempted to defect to West Germany and were all captured or killed. Now assigned to the 666th TSF Squadron as reinforcement to make up for an injured pilot after years as a TSF pilot in Eastern Europe, Lise finally found her cherished brother after three years of searching.

Lise Hohenstein grew up with parents and playwrights Thomas and Marlene in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin. Like those two, Lise wanted to work in theater to bring smiles and dreams to people in a world she considered dark. A talented actress, her career looked like a sure thing until police pressure forced her circle to be disbanded. Like her parents, she staged plays viewed as anti-nationalist and became ostracized for it.

name.native: カティア・ヴァルトハイム
alternative: Ursula Strachwitz (ウルスラ・シュトラハヴィッツ)

node.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5' 1")
__Nationality:__ German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th Schwarzesmarken), German Bundeswehr (101st Battalion)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ F-4 Phantom, MiG-21 Balalaika

A surface pilot in the Bundeswehr, Katia was rescued by the 666th TSF Squadron after the rest of her unit was destroyed. When she applies to defect to the East and asks to join the 666th, Irisdina recommends her as a replacement pilot. 

Katia believes that as long as East and West Germany continue hating each other, they'll never be able to win. Viewed as overly idealistic by others, Katia will stand up for what she believes even if others are too afraid to stand beside her, to the point others consider her a danger to be around in a country where the Stasi operate. 

Though she has little experience as a TSF pilot, she possesses natural talent and instinct, which are things that cannot be taught, which is why people view her as a potential ace pilot. 

~!Katia is East German, born as Ursula Strachwitz, named after the saint. She lived in Berlin and was the daughter of Alfred Strachwitz, the legendary war hero turned dissident leader. Before his persecution, he sent her to West Germany under a different name to live with his old friends from Hamburg, where his will would manifest in her as the idealistic girl who tries to befriend everyone and join the hands of all that fight.!~

name.native: ハインツ・アクスマン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Ministerium für Staatssicherheit
__Rank:__ Oberstleutnant (Lt. Colonel)

The Stasi’s Chief of Operations, Axmann made a name for himself within the organization hunting asylum seekers at East Germany's border, where he captured, imprisoned or executed thousands. 

The Brown Beast's effectiveness, cruelty and sadism in his persecution of dissidents and spies were legendary even by Stasi standards, leading to his prominence within the organization. Axmann's endless pursuit of power and security for himself and the Stasi influenced the significance of the Stasi Armed TSF Force, and the widening of networks of intel and blackmail spanning across Europe, making him hundreds of enemies both outside and inside the Stasi.

name.native: イングヒルト・ブロニコフスキー

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

A member of the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken. Inghild became a surface pilot to give herself a reason to live in East Germany, fighting not for herself, but for everyone else. Born into an impoverished former Junker family, she was constantly bullied growing up for her background and came to hate herself for the reputation Junker families had. 

Inghild is also Anett's best friend, with Anett describing the twos friendship as one where they love each other more than anyone else. Her and Anett have been close friends since their years at the TSF Academy for Gifted Children years ago, when Anett stopped other students from bullying her.

name.native: ベアトリクス・ブレーメ

node.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5' 9")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Stasi Armed Police Force (101st Battalion Wehrwolf) 
__Rank:__ Major
__TSF:__ MiG-23 Cheburashka, MiG-27 Alligator

Commander of the Stasi's infamous Wehrwolf Battalion, and one of the strongest pilots in Europe. With her as commander, Beatrix and her battalion became the symbol of Stasi induced fear in East Germany. Her unparalleled strength captivates many pilots in the Stasi Armed Police Forces to her side, making Major Brehme both the biggest asset and threat to Axmann and Schmidt, as she tries to forge East Germany into her own ideal.

The only child of the nomenklatura Brehme family, the prideful Beatrix grew up struggling to fight her father and predetermined future. When she met Irisdina and later Jürgen, they helped her continue fighting.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Grosser Bär
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)

Suzy Dzap is the ruthless leader of partisans and resistance organization Grosser Bär, and formerly an officer in the NVA. Suzy has a tough and by the book demeanor and appearance, with a scar inflicted by Axmann during an interrogation on the eye she covers with her hair fringe.

One of the central figures of the rebellion and one of its most zealous members, she despises informants and those in the Stasi as traitors who killed many of her comrades over the years and is willing to execute prisoners and use civilians to mask her forces.

name.native: アネット・ホーゼンフェルト

node.description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Anett is a member of the 666th TSF Squadron and one of the few halberd users in the NVA, giving her a reputation as an abnormal pilot wherever she fights. Anett, principled and physically strong and had been enforcing her principles since her days at the TSF Academy protecting Inghild, and continues standing on those principles as best she can as a pilot of the 666th, making it an open secret that's Anett is on the Stasi's radar. 

Anett has a habit of screaming to shake off the fear of death before battle and suffers from PTSD from losing three of her juniors and best friends to the BETA within a few days of each other. Anett knew Theodor from the TSF Military Academy for Gifted Children before the events of the story and cared for him initially, but came to despise Theodor the more she saw him leave others to die.

name.native: グレーテル・イェッケルン

node.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5' 5")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliations:__ Socialist Unity Party of Germany, Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken, 2nd Battalion “Fritz Ulbricht”)
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

The political commissar attached to the 666th unit, tasked with reflecting the will of the Socialist Unity Party and assuring allegiance. The prideful Gretel is the most inexperienced TSF pilot in the 666th, but has the highest authority in the unit. 

Gretel is a sincere socialist, having full pride in it as the ideology which eliminates the gap between rich and poor and considers everyone equally, and pride in East Germany as the nation which embodies the ideals of socialism. 

Gretel graduated from Karl Marx Integrated School as their representative and served in Pioneer, winning national speech competitions along the way, and aimed to join the Schwarzesmarken as the political commissar to get her closer to achieving her goal of rising to a party leader in the SED.

name.native: ヴァルター・クリューガー
alternative: Walther the Crusher (圧砕のヴァルター)

node.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6' 3")
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Walther is a former non-commissioned officer and survivor of Operation Palaiologos, where he likely first met Irisdin. Krüger worked his way up the ranks through the years, eventually being recruited to the 666th as Irisdina's staff officer, later becoming the training manager within the squadron. Though not officially the second-in-command, it's widely known that Krüger is Irisdina's right-hand man and is fiercely loyal to her.

name.native: シルヴィア・クシャシンスカ

node.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5' 7")
__Nationality:__ Polish
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken), Polish Army
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Sylwia is a member of the 666th TSF unit and formerly a pilot for the Polish Army. Extremely blunt and pragmatic, Sylwia is in the war purely for survival, only in the 666th because it increases her chances of survival and allows her to fulfill her goal of killing as many BETA as possible. Her cold attitude causes her to clash with many members of the 666th who might drag the efficient pilot who has been fighting in a TSF since fourteen down. 

Sylwia grew up on the outskirts of Warsaw living a relatively comfortable life, where she'd spend Christmas every year with a feast with her friends and their families. During the retreat from Poland where experienced the horrors of war, she had to flee her home to go West where Irisdina eventually recruited her.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Stasi

Joseph is a member of the Stasi from Axmann’s Berlin faction. He was helping Axmann do many military operations, such as contacting and duties as a radio operator. He has shown exceptional loyalty to Axmann.

__Height:__ 168 cm (5' 6")
__Nationality:__ Vietnamese-East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken)
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Pham Thi-Lan is the second-in-command of the 666th, being described as the spiritual backbone to the unit. Pham is called "Big Sis" by many of the younger surface pilots in the unit. She was recruited by Irisdina to join the 666th a few months after she made an impression on her during the retreat from Poland, when she singled her out because of a conversation she overheard and complimented her smile. 

Pham is a second generation Vietnamese immigrant born in Lichtenberg, a suburb of East Berlin. She is the eldest of five siblings, 10 years older than the next. Being of Vietnamese descent, Pham experienced discrimination growing up in Berlin during wartime, and  she believes her father trained her strictly in Shorinji Kempo as a child to fight it.

name.native: エーリヒ・シュミット

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Ministerium für Staatssicherheit
__Rank:__ Major General

Minister of East Germany's Ministry for State Security. Erich Schmidt displays himself as a charismatic person to persuade and ensure the public that the Stasi rule is just. However, his subordinates know Schmidt as a cold and paranoid individual who will not hesitate to persecute anyone he deems as more dangerous and useful if he feels his dictatorship is in question. 

The Minister came into power after the previous Minister mysteriously died. Since taking power, Schmidt used the deteriorating situation with the BETA and growing discontent among the populace to move the Stasi into a more militant role, putting the fear in the hearts of the DDR's citizens though more brutal and direct means. Schmidt runs the Stasi as his own personal army, and is trying to make the DDR as his own fiefdom.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Stasi
__Rank:__ Oberstleutnant (1st Lt.)

Lieutenant Söhne is a Stasi member belonging to the Berlin faction, and Heinz Axmann’s aide. As Axmann's fanatically-devoted right hand man, he follows him everywhere and will put himself on the line to protect him. In turn, Axmann seems to trust him with his plans.

name.native: ヴィヴィエン・シュヴァインシュタイガー

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (500th Jaeger Corps)
__Rank:__ Sergeant

Vivi carries the rank of Sergeant despite her being fifteen, entailing other infantry personnel much older under her command. As Kurt’s second-in-command at Neuenhagen, she has her head on her shoulders and is very useful to him, placing full trust in her and leaving Katia in her hands. Kurt describes their relationship as rotten, and says that Vivi would be happy to hear it looked to Katia like the two were a couple.

name.native: オットー・シュトラウス

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)

The Schwarzesmarken’s Maintenance Chief, leading a group of a dozen or so maintenance workers. Otto can be relied on to fix any TSF machine that breaks down and helps Irisdina with tweaks to the MiG-21PF. Otto is a World War II survivor and one of the more laid-back of the personnel on Bebersee base.

name.native: キルケ・シュタインホフ

node.description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5' 5")
__Nationality:__ West German
__Affiliation:__ German Bundeswehr (51st Tactical Armored Battalion "Huckebein")
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ F-5G Tornado

Circe Steinhoff is a Bundeswehr pilot from Bonn, West Germany. She has the aura of a cool beauty, but speaks with a sharp tongue and can get caught up in her emotions easily. Circe's bluntness and objectivity to both allies and enemies draws her ire with some and favor with others. In the Huckebein Battalion, Circe is loved and the butt of many jokes made by Commander Balke. 

She hates East Germany for a variety of reasons and has prejudice towards its people for participating in the DDR's society. Despite her prejudice, she desires to protect her family and friends from the BETA, and believes working together with East Germany is the best way to achieve that.

name.native: ホルツァー・ハンニバル

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (Hannibal Battalion, 40th TSF Experimental Group)
__Rank:__ Captain, Major
__TSF:__ MiG-21PF Balalaika

Commander of the Hannibal Battalion. The veteran pilot is one of Irisdina's closest allies, having been her instructor at the TSF Academy. Hannibal views Captain Bernhard and the 666th Squadron as East Germany's most valuable assets. 

Hannibal was originally from the Air Force and an expert in a surface-to-air missile unit. After leaving the Air Force, Hannibal became a TSF pilot and later commander of the 40th TSF Experimental Group, where he first met Jürgen Bernhard.

name.native: マレーネ・ホーエンシュタイン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German

Marlene is Lise Hohenstein’s mother and Theodor’s adopted mother, living in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin. She was dearly loved by the two of them, and a large part of the reason why Lise wanted to work in the theater industry as an adult.

She is a playwright like her husband Thomas, and like him is known for her scripts extolling the virtues of humanity and freedom, which are read as a criticism of the current East Germany’s current regime by many. She was forced out of the industry because of government pressure.

name.native: マライ・ハイゼンベルク

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (Hannibal Battalion)
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

Major Hannibal’s second-in-command. Marai lost her lover on the battlefield a year before the events of the story, and found comfort in Hölzer, who had experienced the same, to forget the sadness she felt. Marai is willing to protect Hannibal with her life.

name.native: トーマス・ホーエンシュタイン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Theatergruppe Straße

Thomas is Lise Hohenstein’s father, from East Berlin. One of Theodor dead father’s distant relatives, he adopted him from an abusive orphanage. 

Thomas founded Theatergruppe Straße as a director in 1966, and slowly gained popularity for works such as “Erinnerungen eines Mädchens” and was eventually being placed in the newspaper for "Mond-Regenbogen" in 1978, a controversial play viewed as anti-nationalistic. After being forced out of the industry and ostracized by the government who accused him of inciting dissidence, Thomas and Marlene became central figures in an asylum plan involving members of the theater and friends in the West who were antagonistic to East Germany.

__Nationality:__ West German
__Affiliation:__ German Bundeswehr (51st Tactical Armored Battalion ‘Huckebein’)
__Rank:__ Major
__TSF:__ F-5G Tornado

Commander of West Germany’s prestigious Huckebein Battalion. Major Balck is a different type of commander from Irisdina, with rough clothes, crude jokes and an easy-going personality, he garners a lot of confidence from his subordinates. He seemingly has the ability to bring anyone of all sides together, be it with alcohol or making fun of his subordinate Circe. As a veteran pilot, Balck is highly skilled and trusted his subordinates for any mission. 

The Major is also married and used to be a fencer when he was younger.

name.native: ヨハネス・ツヴァイクレ

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Socialist Unity Party of Germany
__Rank:__ Major

Johannes Zweig is a member of the SED responsible for ensuring the 666th TSF Squadron completes objectives in line with the desire of the Party during Operation Neptune, regardless of whether or not they are unreasonable in the situation. 

Zweig is Gretel Jecklen’s direct superior, and threatens she and Irisdina will be removed from the squadron if they don’t comply with his demands.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (500th Jaeger Corps & 11th Tank Regiment Willy Bebel)
__Rank:__ Sergeant Major
__Equipment:__ T-62 Tank

Commander of the 500th Jaeger Corps stationed at Fort Neuenhagen. From Dresden, Kurt wanted to be a surface pilot, but failed the aptitude test and had to become infantry, viewed as expendable by military command. Despite his high rank being a result of reckless field promotions, everyone at Fort Neuenhagen recognizes the 18 year old as the most capable for command.

In his early days as a tanker, Kurt experienced hell on the battlefields of East Germany, hiding in carcasses, cleaning hundreds of bodies, being abandoned by the 666th, and losing a girl he liked. Despite getting used to this hell and hating the upper command, Kurt continues fighting, scared that he’ll die without fulfilling his promises and experiencing more life has to offer.

__Nationality:__ West German
__Affiliation:__ German Bundeswehr (51st Tactical Armored Battalion ‘Huckebein’)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ F-5G Tornado

A TSF pilot belonging to Huckebein’s 2nd squadron. Crystal is Circe’s junior officer, colleague and reliable partner on the battlefield, calling her “Senpai”. The leutnant is a bit cocky and doesn’t hesitate to drink when there’s alcohol around. She is also very observant, realizing that Circe was attracted to a certain red-haired boy straight away.

__Nationality:__ American
__Affiliation:__ U.S. Navy’s 103rd TSF Squadron (VF-103) “Jolly Rogers”
__TSF:__ F-14 Tomcat

Commander of “The World’s Strongest”, the U.S. Navy’s Jolly Rogers. John is an American of German descent. Him and the Jolly Rogers Squadron were in the Baltic for Operation Neptune, showing off their new AIM-54 Phoenix launchers.

name.native: エドヴァルド・グラーフ

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee Western Theatre Forces
__Rank:__ Captain

Franz Heim’s loyal aide. Edvard is always at his side, helps with every task and serves as his foremost bodyguard.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee Western Theatre Forces
__Rank:__ Major General

Franz Heim is Commander of the Western Theatre Forces of the NVA, the half of East Germany's military which served in training and social security duties. Heim also has a reputation as a moderate who doesn’t like to get involved in politics, and is considered to be somewhat ineffectual and uncharismatic by his own admission. 

As a friend of Katia Waldheim's father, Alfred Strachwitz, they had known each other for a long time. Heim was the one who introduced him to Ernestine, one of his subordinates at the time.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Stasi Armed Police Force (101st Battalion Wehrwolf)
__Rank:__ Captain
__TSF:__ MiG-23 Cheburashka

Commander of the Wehrwolf Battalion’s Third Borkwalde Squadron. Nichola is one of Beatrix’s most capable subordinates, being left alone to deal with battles against strong groups of the rebels. The Captain is much stricter on the freedom of subordinates than her direct superior Beatrix.

name.native: カタリーナ・ディーゲルマン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Stasi Armed Police Force (101st Battalion Wehrwolf)
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-23 Cheburashka

The second-in-command of the Wehrwolf Battalion’s Brehme Squadron, one of the few in close contact with her. The most talkative and animated of the Battalion, Beatrix makes sure she focuses on things she can control.

name.native: リリー・レーヴィット

__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (612nd TSF Squadron)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

A surface pilot from the 612th TSF Unit from Leipzig, sent to Berlin to aid the Rebel army. Lily and the rest of the 612th were also present during the attack on the Oder-Neisse line in March and were saved by the 666th’s successful laserjagd.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee 
__Rank:__ Oberstleutnant (Lt. Colonel)

Oberstleutnant Meyer is second-in-command at Seelow Fortress position, Berlin’s last line of defense against the BETA. She takes orders and offers suggestions to General Nerlinger.

name.native: ヨーゼフ・マイツェン

node.description:
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (612nd TSF Squadron)
__Rank:__ Leutnant (2nd Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

A surface pilot from the 612th TSF Unit from Leipzig, sent to Berlin to aid the Rebel army. Josef and the rest of the 612th were also present during the attack on the Oder-Neisse line in March and were saved by the 666th’s successful laserjagd.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee
__Rank:__ Major

A corrupt Major working from the Defense Ministry Strategic HQ in East Berlin. During the confusion of the retreat from Poland, Leben stole valuable artwork to sell to the Russian mafia.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Stasi Armed Police Force (101st Battalion Wehrwolf)
__Rank:__ Captain
__TSF:__ MiG-23 Cheburashka

Commander of the Wehrwolf Battalion’s Second Buch Squadron. Rosalinde is another one of the few in close contact with Beatrix, being present at her meeting with Schmidt.

__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee

A maintenance soldier under Otto Strauss. Stationed at Bebersee Base. Tony Zickler is the maintenance soldier most often seen talking to Otto and working on the MiG-21PF, and likely the one Otto trusts most to not be a Stasi informant.

name.native: オイゲン・アルトナー

node.description:
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (612nd TSF Squadron)
__Rank:__ Oberleutnant (1st Lt.)
__TSF:__ MiG-21 Balalaika

A surface pilot from the 612th TSF Unit from Leipzig, sent to Berlin to aid the Rebel army. Eugen and the rest of the 612th were also present during the attack on the Oder-Neisse line in March and were saved by the 666th’s successful laserjagd.

name.native: マルタ・ヴィーデマン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German

A mother that was present at the Stasi protest during the East German Revolution with her husband and child.

name.native: ペーター・ヴィーデマン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German

A father that was present at the Stasi protest during the East German Revolution with his wife and child. After seeing the young Katia on TV, he felt spurred to protest the regime in the streets.

name.native: ハンス・ヴィーデマン

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German

A child that was present at the Stasi protest during the East German Revolution with his mother and father. 

~!Getting carried away by the cheer, Hans helped break down the Berlin wall. After the revolution, Hans and his parents moved to Ireland.!~

name.native: ゲオルグ・リーベルト

node.description:
George Liebert is a maintenance worker under Otto Strauss at Bebersee Base.

~!He is also a Stasi informant.!~

name.native: ヴァレリア・ネルリンガー

node.description:
__Nationality:__ East German
__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee
__Rank:__ Major General

Valeria Nerlinger is a Major General in the NVA, and Commander of Seelow Fortress position, Berlin’s last line of defense against the BETA. As such, she refuses to abandon the Fort regardless of what her subordinates might ask. 

The commander has a 15 year old daughter in Berlin that has been weak ever since birth. She stays at home waiting for her mother to return home.

name.native: ステファン・ミューラァ

node.description:
__Nationality:__ West German
__Affiliation:__ German Bundeswehr

A West German envoy sent with Circe to make contact with the Rebel Army and find out if supporting them was viable. He has some family in East Germany but is unable to visit them because of the Stasi enforced travel restrictions.

__Nationality:__ German

An agent that provides Axmann with documents.

~!Those documents were information about Erich Schmidt’s past. Axmann sourced them to gain favor with Beatrix.!~

name.native: ユルゲン・ベルンハルト

node.description:

Jürgen Bernhard is Irisdina's older brother. He and his beloved sister would live alone together most of their adolescence and develop a very close relationship, with the two operating for the sake of the other. Both an idealist and a realist, the young Jürgen's values in his relationships and in East Germany cause him to become a loved ally to many, and enemy to some. 

When doting over Iris and watching her swimming practice, his attention was grabbed by a tall girl with deep black hair's dive into a pool beautifully and free of hesitation. When he meets Irisdina's rival and later friend, the three's paths would rapidly change along with the world, now facing an alien invasion.

A legendary ace pilot and the pioneer of laserjagd and military strategies that influenced humanities fight against the BETA to come; Jürgen's legacy is felt throughout the entire series.

__Affiliation:__ Nationale Volksarmee (1st Tank Corps)
__Rank:__ Major General, Lieutenant General

Alfred Strachwitz is a highly regarded General in the NVA. Alfred and Jürgen clash over the future of East Germany's fight against the BETA, with him believing a ground force is best, while Jürgen believed an TSF-based doctrine was best. While the outcome of their clash could ultimately mean life or death for Europe, the two became very close allies and somewhat of a mentor to the young Jürgen. 

Alfred is also a father to a 4 year old daughter Ursula Strachwitz, named after Saint Ursula. Alfred never misses an opportunity to show off photos of her or talk about her latest escapades. His wife and her mother Ernestine 'Tini' Strachwitz died during childbirth.

Alfred was highly regarded in the field, and was praised by the Soviets for his job as commander of the 9th Tank Division during the Prague Spring. Strachwitz later moved to the General Staff and became a key figure in the modification of the East German army's doctrine. With the 1st Tank Corps now in the BETA war, he had success in Ukraine raising his status as a hero. 

Schwarzesmarken 1983 spoilers:
!~Alfred was also one of the key critics of his government, and his charisma, influence and great publicity posed a danger that the Stasi could not ignore. The general and his whole family, save for Ursula, were wiped out in the Moonlit Night purges and the name Strachwitz was struck from state records and proscribed.~!

Martin Karel was the child of a party official, but was a problem child at Karl Marx Integrated School. As a student, Karel was accused of criticizing socialism and the current East German regime. He also carries around a knife for self defense.

~!Martin despises the government because of the corruption. The secret dumping of industrial waste in Bitterfeld caused his cousin along with many in the area to become extremely ill. Because the Stasi wanted it to be secret, his cousin wasn’t allowed better treatment in Berlin and he couldn’t voice criticism. Despite that, he does like the ideals associated with socialism, and wished that someone could correct the problems brought about by the Stasi being the one upholding them.!~
